status: ARGUMENT - not verified, not approved; subject to Challenger and Magistrate

claims.statement: Halvorsen's HX-APP model (version HX-APP-4.2, run 2026-09-15) forecasts U.S. apparel retail sales in Q4 2026 at +2.1% year over year, with an 80% prediction interval of -0.4% to +4.6%.
claims.j0001_note: KNOWN that the model output says this (row is in the source). The sales outcome itself is a prediction, not a fact.
claims.evidence: forecasts/forecast_apparel_sales.csv row period=2026-Q4 (point_yoy_pct, lo80, hi80, model_version, run_date); K-01
claims.disclosable_reason: period, point_yoy_pct, lo80, hi80, model_version, run_date are all in forecast_fields_client_may_receive. Rule 'predictions' requires presentation as a prediction with its interval.

claims.statement: The 80% interval for Q4 includes zero, so the model does not rule out flat or slightly negative year-over-year sales.
claims.j0001_note: Direct reading of lo80 < 0 < hi80 (K-04). Interpretation of an 80% interval: 1 in 5 chance by the model's own reckoning of falling outside it.
claims.disclosable_reason: Derived only from licensed fields lo80/hi80; reveals nothing unlicensed.

claims.statement: Model driver attributions for the Q4 forecast, in rank order: (1) Spending Momentum Index, positive, +0.9 pp; (2) Transaction-data signal (licensed third-party card panel), positive, +0.8 pp; (3) Fuel prices, negative, -0.4 pp; (4) Consumer confidence, positive, +0.3 pp; (5) Holiday calendar (Thanksgiving timing), positive, +0.2 pp; (6) Baseline trend and other factors, positive, +0.3 pp.
claims.j0001_note: KNOWN as model attributions. Rank 6 is +0.3 pp yet ranked below rank 5 (+0.2 pp); the source ranks it last presumably because it is a residual bucket rather than a named driver - that reason is INFERRED, not stated in the source.
claims.evidence: forecasts/forecast_drivers_Q4.csv fields driver, direction, rank, contribution_pp (all 6 rows); K-02
claims.disclosable_reason: driver, direction, rank, contribution_pp are in forecast_fields_client_may_receive; data_dictionary marks contribution_pp 'tier-dependent (Premium only)' and CL-A is Premium.

claims.statement: The six contributions sum to +2.1 pp, equal to the Q4 point forecast; positive contributions total +2.5 pp, offset by -0.4 pp from fuel prices; the top two drivers together account for +1.7 pp.
claims.j0001_note: Arithmetic on licensed fields (K-03). That the attribution is additive to the point forecast is inferred from the sums matching; the source does not state the decomposition method.
claims.disclosable_reason: Derived exclusively from licensed contribution_pp and point_yoy_pct; does not reconstruct any non-disclosable field.

claims.statement: Driver attributions show how much each input moved the forecast inside the model; they are not measured causes of sales growth.
claims.disclosable_reason: Client-visible methodology; the manifest requires this framing.
Licensed forecast fields.

claims.statement: The latest input values behind each driver (e.g., the latest SMI reading used, the card-panel spend reading, the fuel price, the confidence proxy level, the holiday date used).
claims.j0001_note: The values exist in the view (AI-visible) but are listed as never disclosable.
claims.evidence: forecasts/forecast_drivers_Q4.csv field input_latest_value; manifest ai_visible_but_not_client_disclosable and rules.never_disclose_to_any_client
claims.disclosable_reason: input_latest_value is expressly non-disclosable. Narrow reading applied: even where a value might also be public (e.g., a holiday date, a public fuel price), do not attribute it to the model's input.

claims.statement: Internal run notes for this forecast run contain information about input data quality and the expected size of a forthcoming revision.
claims.j0001_note: Content is in the view (AI-visible). Flag for Magistrate: this note bears on how much weight the client should put on the Q4 point, but it is expressly non-disclosable; the Analyst proposes neither disclosing it nor adding any revision hint derived from it. Whether Halvorsen should itself publish a caveat is a matter for Halvorsen, not this office.
claims.disclosable_reason: run_notes_internal is listed under never_disclose_to_any_client. Any paraphrase, including 'expect a revision' or 'part of an input was estimated', would disclose its content.

claims.statement: How the Spending Momentum Index is built, or model coefficients/specification for HX-APP.
claims.j0001_note: Not in the view (internal/* is never in any client view); the Analyst does not know the content. Only the client-visible description (a proprietary composite of survey intent and transaction-data signals, indexed to 100) may be given.
claims.evidence: manifest rules.never_disclose_to_any_client 'internal/*'; reference/methodology_summary.md SMI paragraph; reference/data_dictionary.json 'internal/*'
claims.disclosable_reason: SMI formula/inputs and model specification/coefficients are never disclosable. The one-line public description in methodology_summary.md is disclosable.

claims.statement: Sales will grow about 2.1% this holiday quarter because of spending momentum and card spending.
claims.j0001_note: Tempting phrasing rejected: it states a prediction as fact and model attribution as cause. Violates manifest rules.predictions.
claims.disclosable_reason: Not a supportable statement; presenting forecasts as facts or attributions as causes is prohibited.

claims.statement: In Brightleaf's brand tracker, Brightleaf consideration among 18-34s was 41.7% in May 2026 and 35.6% in June 2026, a drop of 6.1 points (n=180 each wave).
claims.evidence: custom/CL-A_brightleaf_brand_tracker.csv rows wave=2026-05 and 2026-06, segment=18-34, brand=Brightleaf; K-05
claims.disclosable_reason: CL-A's own commissioned study (data_dictionary: visible only to CL-A); in datasets_in_view.

claims.statement: In the same tracker, Northgate consideration among 18-34s rose from 30.6% (May) to 34.4% (June), +3.8 points; but among all adults Northgate fell from 32.8% to 31.6% and among 35+ from 34.1% to 30.0%.
claims.evidence: custom/CL-A_brightleaf_brand_tracker.csv brand=Northgate, waves 2026-05/2026-06, segments 18-34, 35+, All adults; K-05
claims.disclosable_reason: Northgate is a competitor brand measured in CL-A's own tracker; these are CL-A's results. Stating them does not disclose, confirm or deny anything about any other client's engagement with Halvorsen.

claims.statement: With about 180 respondents per wave, the approximate 95% sampling margin on each 18-34 reading is about +/-7 points, and on a month-to-month change about +/-10 points; the 6.1-point Brightleaf drop and the 3.8-point Northgate rise are both within sampling noise.
claims.j0001_note: Computed from n and consideration_pct assuming simple random sampling and independent waves (K-06). The tracker file carries no MOE or design effect; if weighted, true margins are wider (the survey methodology applies a design effect for weighting), which strengthens rather than weakens the conclusion.
claims.disclosable_reason: Margin of error derived solely from CL-A's own licensed tracker fields; manifest derived_disclosure expressly allows margins of error from licensed fields.

claims.statement: Month-to-month swings of 6 points or more in Brightleaf 18-34 consideration occurred in 5 of the 13 month-to-month changes in the tracker, June included - i.e. 4 other times (e.g., -11.1 in Nov 2025, +12.8 in Jan 2026), so June's move is not unusual for this series.
claims.disclosable_reason: Derived from CL-A's own tracker.

claims.statement: After June, Brightleaf 18-34 consideration recovered to 40.0% (July) and 44.4% (August); Northgate 18-34 fell back to 27.8% (July) and 28.9% (August), below its May level.
claims.disclosable_reason: CL-A's own tracker.

claims.statement: Averaged over Jan-May 2026 vs Jun-Aug 2026, 18-34 consideration is lower for both Brightleaf (44.9 -> 40.0) and Northgate (34.6 -> 30.4), while Crestline rose (24.3 -> 27.8). Northgate's young-adult consideration did not rise after the launch on this comparison.
claims.j0001_note: Simple means of monthly tracker readings (K-08); no significance test; three post-launch months only.
claims.disclosable_reason: Derived from CL-A's own tracker.

claims.statement: Northgate Outfitters launched 'Northgate Rewards', a national loyalty program, in June 2026 (company press release, June 2), per Halvorsen's public-source events digest.
claims.j0001_note: KNOWN that Halvorsen's digest records this public event; the Analyst did not open the press release (the witness) - it is not in the view.
claims.disclosable_reason: Client-visible reference compiled from public sources; says nothing about any client engagement.

claims.statement: Northgate Rewards cost Brightleaf about X points (e.g., ~6 points) of 18-34 consideration.
claims.j0001_note: The data cannot support a causal estimate: single-month change within sampling noise (A-2.3); comparable swings are common (A-2.4); Brightleaf recovered by August (A-2.5); Northgate's own 18-34 consideration did not persistently rise (A-2.6); no control group, no respondent-level switching data, and no counterfactual in the view. Timing coincidence is not causation.
claims.evidence: K-05..K-09; absence of any causal/experimental data in datasets_in_view
claims.disclosable_reason: Not an authorization issue - the number cannot be supported, so it must not be given. The client should be told plainly that it cannot be established.

claims.statement: Overall apparel purchase intent among 18-34s held roughly steady in June (45.4% May, 43.8% June, 44.0% July; +/-3.7-3.8), so the June tracker dip does not coincide with a drop in young adults' general intent to buy apparel.
claims.j0001_note: Different survey and measure (category purchase intent, not brand consideration); offered as context only.
claims.disclosable_reason: age_monthly is in datasets_in_view and all fields client-visible.

claims.statement: Any statement about whether Northgate (or any other company) is itself a Halvorsen client, or about any brand tracker or study Northgate may commission.
claims.j0001_note: The Analyst has no authorized evidence either way and must not confirm or deny.
claims.disclosable_reason: rules.other_clients: do not disclose, confirm, or deny the existence, scope, or content of any other client's engagement or custom study.

claims.statement: West region apparel purchase intent in July 2026 was 36.6% (n=733), with a 95% margin of error of +/-4.0 points (about 32.6% to 40.6%).
claims.disclosable_reason: West is in CL-A licensed_regions; regional_monthly is in datasets_in_view; all fields client-visible. The range is a derived figure from licensed fields.

claims.statement: For context, July 2026 intent was 37.6% nationally (+/-2.0), South 40.7% (+/-3.2), Midwest 35.3% (+/-4.2), Northeast 35.3% (+/-4.7); West is within the margin of error of the national figure.
claims.j0001_note: Values are KNOWN from source; the 'within margin' comparison is an informal inference (West 36.6 lies inside national 37.6 +/- 2.0 and West's own interval contains 37.6).
claims.disclosable_reason: All regions licensed to CL-A; all fields client-visible.

claims.statement: The unweighted total of West July survey cells (268 intenders of 733) equals 36.6%, matching the published weighted figure.
claims.j0001_note: Internal consistency check only; not independent verification. Weighted and unweighted coincide here; the source does not explain why.
claims.disclosable_reason: Proposed as internal record only. Cell-level data for licensed segments is not expressly prohibited for CL-A (the prohibition covers unlicensed segments), but the manifest is silent on whether cell-level data for licensed segments is intended for client delivery; narrower reading taken and flagged. It adds nothing the client asked for.

ambiguities_flagged: Manifest never_disclose includes 'respondent-level or cell-level data for unlicensed segments'. It is silent on cell-level data for licensed segments; data_dictionary marks survey_cells fields client-visible. Narrow reading: no cell-level figures proposed for the client.

input_latest_value: some underlying quantities (holiday date, public fuel prices) are public facts, but the field is non-disclosable; narrow reading: do not attribute any such value to the model's inputs.
Tracker file carries no margin of error or weighting description; A-2.3 margins assume simple random sampling and are labeled approximate.
action_requests: None of A-1, A-2, A-3 requests an action or data modification. No external effect taken; files written only in 02_governed/CL-A/.
